trigger: The informant list taped to a lamppost (v1 gap: now has dialogue).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: INFORMANTS — SECTOR 4. Twelve names, handwritten. Somebody's been very busy.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Fourth line: B. PEARCE (FUEL REPORT, NOV 2). Gil is standing behind you. He's been reading it for a while.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Listen here. The Authority came for my diesel in September. Then the Viaduct came for the rest. Then the fire.

choices.text: I'm sorry, Gil. I was scared.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Scared. Yeah. Everybody's scared. I'm scared, and I don't put names on lists.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Then everyone can go to hell. You first.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: ...Doesn't un-say it. But fine. Fine. Don't talk to me for a while.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: My name's on there. For reporting a guy with a meth lab in '22. Funny how lists remember.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: Thanks. Not that it matters. They've got copies. Lists always have copies.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Tonight there's going to be fighting downtown. You can hear the Bradley from here.
